craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta as saṃsāra denied — tranquility of no-rite; vyabhicāri steadiness (denial that steadies). Sanskrit-first: nāsti tattvataḥ (is NOT, in truth — denial with the truth-word inside it); vitathā (FALSE — the rite-word itself falsified); yathāvasthitaḥ (staying AS-IT-IS — the whole anupāya doctrine in the last word). Rows: 9 (mā…mā double prohibition — abandon/grasp anaphora already in L3, kept), 2 (rope-snake-shadow-ghost heap kept whole — density IS the diagnosis), 1 (‘staying as you are’ end-weighted), 12 (śānta-fall: live-healthy-staying settles). Close: ‘staying as you are’. Rupture: ‘Abandon nothing; grasp nothing —’ (diagnosis turns to rule; the dash holds the turn). Rejected: ornamenting the heap — killed: adorning a verse that refuses method would contradict its doctrine (restraint IS the music); ‘be well’ for svasthaḥ — killed: healthy-steady, not wellness; ‘what talk of bondage’ smoothing — killed: vārtā (news/report) kept as asked-question. Read aloud: FOR-bo-dy-BEAR-ers, sam-SĀ-ra … is NOT — … a-BAN-don NO-thing; GRASP no-thing — LIVE-heal-thy, STAY-ing AS you ARE.

lines: For body-bearers, Saṃsāra in truth is not — of bondage, what news?
Bondage never truly is anyone’s — so the liberation-rite is false.
This error-maker: rope-snake-shadow-ghost delusion. Abandon nothing; grasp nothing —
live healthy, staying as you are.

reads_against.argmap: Is saṃsāra real, and what follows? → Saṃsāra is delusion; bondage is unreal; the liberation-rite is false; abandon nothing, grasp nothing, stay.
c1_essence: Saṃsāra is unreal for the embodied; bondage never truly is for anyone, so the liberation-rite is false. The error is a fourfold delusion-heap — rope, snake, shadow, ghost. Abandon nothing, grasp nothing; live healthy, staying.
